description: Monitoring Freebox POP with InfluxDB v2 and Grafana

targets.query:
from(bucket: "freebox")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "freebox")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tag1"] == "box")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bandwidth")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["endpoint"] == "mafreebox.freebox.fr")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "telegraf")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tag2"] == "down" or r["tag2"] == "up")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement"])
  |> keep(columns: ["tag2", "_value"])

from(bucket: "freebox")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "freebox")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tag1"] == "box")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tag2"] == "down" or r["tag2"] == "up")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["endpoint"] == "mafreebox.freebox.fr")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "telegraf")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "tag2"])

from(bucket: "freebox")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "freebox")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tag1"] == "box")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "sfp_has_signal" or r["_field"] == "ipv4" or r["_field"] == "ipv6" or r["_field"] == "media")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "tag1", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_measurement"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["media", "ipv4", "ipv6","sfp_has_signal"])
